title: 4011. Count Subarrays With Even Odd Ratio I

examples.explanation: The following are the valid subarrays: Subarray Values Even Count Odd Count Ratio nums[0..0] [1] 0 1 0 / 1 nums[0..1] [1, 2] 1 1 1 / 1 nums[0..2] [1, 2, 1] 1 2 1 / 2 nums[0..3] [1, 2, 1, 2] 2 2 2 / 2 nums[1..2] [2, 1] 1 1 1 / 1 nums[2..2] [1] 0 1 0 / 1 nums[2..3] [1, 2] 1 1 1 / 1 Thus, the number of valid subarrays is 7.

The following are the valid subarrays: Subarray Values Even Count Odd Count Ratio nums[0..2] [2, 2, 1] 2 1 2 / 1 nums[1..2] [2, 1] 1 1 1 / 1 nums[2..2] [1] 0 1 0 / 1 Thus, the number of valid subarrays is 3.
Every subarray contains 0 odd numbers, so no subarray is valid.
